Read the page, not the popups

A Safari extension • by Luna Reader

Stop popups and blocking ads, automatically. Unblock and read most of the web, without leaving Safari. When you want the full Luna experience, its one tap away. Don't worry. All your data is offline. There are no Luna servers to send anything to. And there's a whole family of Luna apps so you can do more in Safari.

Turn it on in Safari

  1. Tap the page menu in the address bar
  2. Choose “Manage Extensions”
  3. Switch on Luna Reader
